title: Who's Who & Your Legal Status
dek: Your first month is mostly about finding out who to ask. Here is the map: five offices, three key people, one legal red line, five phone numbers.
dek_zh: 認識校園組織、你的法律身分，以及一定不能踩的那條線。
notice:
This is not an evaluation

Your score is shown only to you. It is never shared with your school, your co-teacher, or the Education Department, and it has no connection to your contract renewal or any performance review.

We report only anonymous group statistics — for example, “68% of us got the reporting deadline right” — so we know which topics to explain better at the next meeting. Answer honestly. A wrong answer here is exactly what this is for. Retakes are unlimited and are not recorded.

title: The School Day & the Calendar
dek: Module 1 gave you the people. This one gives you the clock. Most first-year frustration is not cultural — it is the simple fact that nobody handed you the calendar, and the calendar is where every decision in a Taiwanese school actually lives.
dek_zh: 作息與行事曆：學年結構、段考、補課日、大型活動，以及如何在這樣的節奏裡排你的課。

title: Discipline Without Corporal Punishment
dek: By November the honeymoon is over and you have a class you cannot settle. This module is the short version of what you are allowed to do about it — which is more than most foreign teachers assume, and narrower in one specific direction than almost anyone expects.
dek_zh: 零體罰的班級經營：法源、可以用的管教措施、絕對不能碰的界線，以及外師實際上的升級路徑。
notice:

title: Child Protection & Mandatory Reporting
dek: This is the module with legal consequences attached. In Taiwan, educators are mandated reporters. If you suspect a child is being harmed, telling someone is not a judgment call you get to make — it is a duty with a 24-hour clock on it.
dek_zh: 兒少保護與法定通報：24 小時的法定義務、你的角色，以及當下該做與不該做的事。
notice:
This is not an evaluation

Your score is shown only to you. It is never shared with your school, your co-teacher, or the Education Department, and it has no connection to your contract renewal or any performance review.

This module matters more than most. If you get questions wrong here, that is useful — for you and for us. Read the explanations, retake as many times as you like, and bring your questions to the December meeting.

本測驗與任何考評、續聘無關。個人分數只有你自己看得到。本月主題涉及法定義務，請務必讀完說明。

title: Gender Equity & Professional Boundaries
dek: Two things at once: a reporting duty with the largest fine of any module in this series, and a set of everyday habits that keep you — and your students — well clear of ever needing it.
dek_zh: 性別平等與師生界線：24 小時通報義務、校園性別事件的定義，以及日常該守住的距離。

title: Bullying Prevention
dek: The third and last module with a 24-hour clock on it. It is also the one where you are most likely to be the only adult who sees anything — because bullying happens in exactly the places a homeroom teacher is not, and in exactly the lesson format you use.
dek_zh: 校園霸凌防制：113 年新制下的定義、通報義務、調和程序，以及外師實際能做的事。

title: Privacy, Photos & Talking to Parents
dek: No 24-hour clock this month. Instead, the quiet mistakes — the class photo on your own Instagram, the worksheet you uploaded, the parent who asked you one question too many. None of them feel like breaches at the time.
dek_zh: 個資、照片、教材著作權與親師溝通：課堂可以做的，放上網路就不一定可以。

title: Co-teaching & Workplace Culture
dek: The only module in this series with almost no law in it. These are norms, not rules — descriptions of how the place tends to work, offered so that you can read a room you did not grow up in. Where your school differs, your school is right and this page is wrong.
dek_zh: 協同教學與職場文化：面子、間接拒絕、會議、聚餐、送禮，以及續聘前該有的對話。
notice:
This is not an evaluation — and these are not rules

Your score is shown only to you. It is never shared with your school, your co-teacher, or the Education Department, and it has no connection to your contract renewal or any performance review.

Everything in this module is observed practice, not regulation. Nobody is required to like any of it, and a school that does things differently is not doing them wrongly. The purpose is to make the patterns visible, so that what currently reads as rudeness or evasion reads as something you can work with.

本測驗與任何考評、續聘無關。本月內容屬於文化觀察與慣例描述，非法規要求。

sources:
• There is no statute behind most of this page. It describes observed practice in Changhua schools, collected from foreign teachers and their co-teachers.
  • The exception is gifts: public-school staff are subject to rules on receiving gifts and benefits. When in doubt, decline and tell your school.
  • Where a duty from Modules 4, 5 or 6 applies, it overrides everything on this page — including the escalation etiquette.
  • Disagree with something here? Say so in Q20. This module should be corrected by the people living it.

title: Assessment & Closing the Year
dek: You probably do not own a single grade on any report card. But your judgement feeds one — and the rules about what a grade may say, and what it may never say, are stricter than most teachers arriving from abroad expect.
dek_zh: 評量與學年結束：評量方式、成績怎麼記、為什麼不能公布排名，以及續聘與離職的時程。
